summary: Reject a blocked license and a forged identity
description: T8-6, SEC-06, and SEC-07. A blocked license does not call the upstream. A forged user header does not change the user on the event.
scope: The upstream client is not called while the license is blocked
The emitted user hash matches alice, not bob
acceptanceCriteria: With a blocked cache, the upstream request count is 0 and the status is 403. With an active license, header X-User-Id bob and key k-alice produce a stored user hash of alice, and the event text does not contain bob. T8-6 SEC-06 SEC-07.
constraints: Do not call the upstream when the license is blocked.
Do not hash the header user instead of the key user.
Do not put bob in the event.
